# shumoku_dashboard (Resource)

A Shumoku dashboard: a grid of widgets described by a layout JSON document.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shumoku_dashboard" "noc" {
  name = "NOC"
  layout_json = jsonencode({
    columns   = 12
    rowHeight = 100
    margin    = 8
    widgets   = []
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `layout_json` (String) The dashboard layout as a JSON string (use `jsonencode`). Shape as the server UI writes it: `{columns, rowHeight, margin, widgets: [...]}`. Compared semantically, so key order and whitespace do not cause diffs. When omitted, the server's default (an empty 12-column grid) is used and then kept; layouts edited in the UI show up as drift when this is set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Creation time, Unix milliseconds.
- `id` (String) Server-generated dashboard id.
- `share_token` (String, Sensitive) Public share token, empty when sharing is disabled. Read-only here.
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update time, Unix milliseconds.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A dashboard is imported by its id.
terraform import shumoku_dashboard.noc <dashboard_id>
```
